tv.name: Auto direction
tv.keyHint: T key: turn on or off
tv.unavailable: Without the 3D scene there is no auto direction

hint.what: The camera picks what to show by itself. In a race, the closest battle by the official timing tower interval (under {s} s), preferring those further ahead. Without official intervals (practice, qualifying or sessions without a tower), two cars running close together on track.
hint.number: The only figure it gives is the tower interval; if it picks them by how close they are on track, it gives none.
hint.neutral: In a race, under a safety car (real or virtual), it follows the leader of the classification; under a red flag, or outside a race, the overview.
hint.cuts: It chases the pair or watches them go by from a fixed camera at some corners, and never cuts more than once every {s} s.
hint.exit: It turns off as soon as you touch anything: picking or following a car, moving the map, Esc or the T key.

chip.label: Auto direction
chip.towerTitle: The figure is the official timing tower interval.
chip.proximityTitle: Picked because they are close on track: without an official interval, no figure is given.
chip.leaderTitle: The leader according to the official classification.
